map.本地处理:全角半角/多余空格/标点规范/字数统计/同义词替换: Local processing: full-width and half-width forms, extra spaces, punctuation normalization, character count, synonym replacement
map.润色分两步：先做格式规范化（全角半角、多余空格、标点规范、行首尾空格），再做本地: Polishing runs in two steps. First it normalizes formatting (full-width and half-width forms, extra spaces, punctuation, leading and trailing spaces), then performs local colloquial and redundancy cleanup (removing filler words such as "I think", "actually", "that is to say" and "that one", rewriting colloquial connectives, merging repeated words, and splitting overlong sentences at commas). All rules run locally in the browser and never depend on any network API. The result area shows how many changes were made and a breakdown by category.

map.全角转半角(字母数字): Convert full-width to half-width (letters and digits)
map.中英文间加空格: Insert a space between Chinese and English
map.💡 同义词替换:选中输出文本中的中文词语,系统会从本地词库推荐替换词;点击推荐词: 💡 Synonym replacement: select a Chinese word in the output; the tool suggests replacements from a local thesaurus. Click a suggestion to replace the first occurrence in the output only — the input text is untouched, and no whole-text rewrite or paraphrase is performed.
map.公文/邮件润色：删除口语填充词（我觉得/我认为/其实/就是说/那个/怎么说呢），: Official documents and emails: delete colloquial fillers such as "I think", "actually", "that is to say" and "that one", change "then" to "subsequently", and normalize punctuation and spacing. No whole-sentence rewriting.
map.论文/报告改写：清理口水词、合并连续重复词组、拆分超长句；不提供降重，同义词仅作: Papers and reports: remove filler words, merge consecutive duplicate phrases and split overlong sentences. No similarity reduction (paraphrasing); synonyms are suggestions that you confirm manually.
map.社媒文案打磨：规范全半角/标点/空格并拆分长句，保持原语气；不做风格化改写。: Social media copy: normalize full-width/half-width forms, punctuation and spacing, and split long sentences while keeping the original tone. No stylistic rewriting.
map.原文「我觉得那个事情然后你尽快看看弄一下」→ 输出「事情随后你尽快看看弄一下」：: Input "I think that thing, then please look at it soon" becomes "That thing, subsequently please look at it soon": the fillers "I think" and "that one" are removed and "then" becomes "subsequently". The rest is the original wording; this tool does not rewrite meaning.
map.润色会改变原意吗？: Does Polishing Change the Original Meaning?
map.只做填充词删除、连续重复合并、长句拆分与格式规范，不改写句意；同义词替换需你在输: It only removes filler words, merges duplicates, splits long sentences and normalizes formatting; meaning is not rewritten. Synonym replacement requires you to select a word in the output and confirm by clicking, and the input text stays as-is.
map.不提供风格切换（无正式/简洁等档位）。本工具只做规则化清理，选中输出中的词语可查: No style switching (no formal/concise presets). This tool performs rule-based cleanup only; select a word in the output to see synonym suggestions and click to replace.
